$comment: GENERATED by backend/forge/tools/measure_so101.py from sim/so101/model (MuJoCo Menagerie robotstudio_so101, Apache-2.0). Edit the script, not this file.
frames: Each interface is given in the MuJoCo body frame named in `body` (sim/so101/model/so101.xml), in mm. The gripper frame: z runs from the wrist (z≈0) to the jaw tips (z≈-104), the fixed jaw is on -x, the moving jaw on +x, the wrist-camera side is +y.
source_note: Measured on decimated sim meshes, not on the original CAD: features can be off by ±0.5 mm; hole diameters on decimated meshes read small. Every value must be checked on a real print (ověřit na tisku).

interfaces.name: Fixed jaw, camera face (+y)
interfaces.fastener: M3 (screws through the add-on into the jaw holes; the wrist camera mount uses the same pair). Length = existing screw + add-on plate thickness.
interfaces.fastener_cs: M3 (šrouby přes díl do otvorů v čelisti; stejnou dvojici používá držák zápěstní kamery). Délka = původní šroub + tloušťka destičky.

other_features.note: Ø≈4 mm opening not used by the camera mount (purpose unknown, not a mounting hole for this library).

counterbore_inside_jaw.note: Wider pocket ≈4 mm below the face: probably for a nut or screw head from the inside (not confirmed).

clearance_envelope.note: Free space next to the camera mount for an add-on, before the collision check: x -40…-23, y 24…60, z -50…-10 (gripper frame).

interfaces.use: Add-ons that rotate with the gripper (lights, small sensors). With the wrist camera fitted, sandwich a ≤3 mm plate under the camera mount (the camera moves 3 mm along +y).

interfaces.name: Fixed jaw, outer face (-x)
interfaces.features_note: One Ø≈10 mm round recess coaxial with the jaw servo (z≈-23.4) and Ø≈1.5 mm marks; no screw holes usable for mounting.
interfaces.fastener: None in the part: double-sided foam tape (VHB-type) or a clip around the jaw. Drilling the jaw is not recommended.
interfaces.fastener_cs: Žádné otvory: oboustranná pěnová páska (typ VHB) nebo klip kolem čelisti. Vrtání čelisti nedoporučujeme.
interfaces.use: Very light add-ons (< 10 g) when the camera face is taken; the face touches objects when grasping wide items.

interfaces.name: Forearm band clamp
interfaces.fastener: Printed two-piece band with 2× M3 screws + nuts, or two cable ties through a printed saddle. Keep ≥1 mm clearance to the elbow and wrist servo cables.
interfaces.fastener_cs: Tištěná dvoudílná objímka se 2× M3 + matice, nebo dvě stahovací pásky přes tištěné sedlo. Nechat ≥1 mm vůli ke kabelům serv.
interfaces.use: Add-ons that should not rotate with the wrist (work light aimed at the table, cable strain relief).
